item.title: How Students Choose Essay Writing Services
item.description: Essay writing services have become a common part of student life, especially in demanding academic environments where deadlines, part-time jobs, and personal responsibilities often collide.

item.title: Troy Baseball opens 2026 at Mercer
item.description: Troy baseball opens 2026 with a 1-3 road series at Mercer, highlighted by a 19-3 win and Drew Nelson’s strong weekend at the plate, before a road test at No. 3 Mississippi State.

item.title: CHHS Grad Zac Etheridge hired by Arizona Cardinals
item.description: CHHS grad and ex-Auburn star Zac Etheridge is joining the Arizona Cardinals as cornerbacks coach after guiding Miami’s ACC-best pass defense to the CFP national title game.

item.title: Troy Softball wins four in Cardinal Clash, battles weather
item.description: Troy softball improves to 8-1 with four wins at the Cardinal Clash, including three run-rule victories and a walk-off over Radford, before severe weather ends the tournament early.

item.title: Troy men lose second straight, women win second straight
item.description: Troy women edge ULM 82-80 for their second straight win and stay tied atop the Sun Belt, while the men drop a second straight in a 69-65 loss at Southern Miss.

item.title: Steps to Cope with Stress and Build Resilience
item.description: Life is full of uncertainties, and we all have to tackle various stressors daily.

item.title: Dreamer Life: Troy native Jay Barnes’ journey from dreamer to author
item.description: Troy native and Alabama A&M student Jay Barnes has turned early story ideas into four published books in under a year, using his Dreamer Life brand to inspire others to chase their dreams.

item.title: Charles Henderson, Ariton gear up for Regional Basketball Tournament
item.description: Charles Henderson boys and girls and Ariton boys head to Garrett Coliseum in Montgomery for South Regional basketball, opening against Eufaula and Providence Christian this week.

item.title: OBITUARY: Virginia Lee Hughes Blackmon
item.description: Virginia Lee Hughes Blackmon, 88, remembered for her faith, selfless love, and welcoming table, died Feb. 14, 2026; graveside services Feb. 17 at Providence Cemetery, Glenwood.

item.title: OBITUARY: Michael "Mike" Dean Carr
item.description: Michael “Mike” Dean Carr, 66, of Jack, AL, remembered for his kindness, humor and love of cooking, died suddenly Feb. 10, 2026; he is survived by his children and grandchildren.
